-----------------------------------------------------------------------

DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR

Bureau of Ocean Energy Management

[Docket No. BOEM-2026-0925]


Notice of Availability of the Proposed Notice of Sale for the 
Cook Inlet Outer Continental Shelf Oil and Gas One Big Beautiful Bill 
Act Lease Sale 2

AGENCY: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management, Interior.

ACTION: Notice of availability for the proposed notice of sale.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY: The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) announces the 
availability of the Proposed Notice of Sale (NOS) for the Cook Inlet 
Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) Oil and Gas One Big Beautiful Bill Act 
(OBBBA) Lease Sale 2 (Lease Sale BBC2). BOEM is publishing this notice 
pursuant to its regulatory authority under 30 CFR part 556. Pursuant to 
Section 19 of the OCS Lands Act, the Secretary of the Interior provides 
the Governors of affected States and the executive of any affected 
local government with the opportunity to review and comment on the 
Proposed NOS. The Proposed NOS describes the proposed size, timing, and 
location of the sale, including lease stipulations, terms and 
conditions, minimum bids, royalty rates, and rental rates, which are 
required by Section 50102 of the OBBBA for this sale.

DATES: Comments received from the Governor and the executive of any 
affected local government on the size, timing, and location of this 
sale must be submitted to BOEM no later than December 14, 2026. BOEM 
will publish the Final NOS in the Federal Register at least 30 days 
prior to the date of bid opening. Bid opening is currently scheduled 
for March 3, 2027.

ADDRESSES: The Proposed NOS for Lease Sale BBC2 and Proposed NOS 
Package containing information essential to potential bidders may be 
obtained from the Leasing Section, Alaska Region, Bureau of Ocean 
Energy Management, 3801 Centerpoint Drive, Suite 500, Anchorage, AK 
99503; telephone: 907-334-5200. The Proposed NOS and Proposed NOS 
Package are available for downloading or viewing on

[[Page 64942]]

BOEM's website at <a href="http://www.boem.gov/ak-bbc2/">http://www.boem.gov/ak-bbc2/</a>.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Joel Immaraj, Alaska Regional 
Supervisor, Office of Leasing and Plans, 907-334-5238, 
[email protected] or Ben Burnett, Division Manager, Leasing Policy 
and Management Division, Office of Strategic Resources, 703-787-1782, 
[email protected].

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: 
    Authority: This sale will be held pursuant to the requirements of 
the OBBBA. This Notice of Availability of the Proposed NOS is published 
pursuant to 43 U.S.C. 1331 et seq. (Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act, 
as amended) and 30 CFR 556.304. Secretary's Order 3451 established the 
Marine Minerals Administration (MMA) and incorporated the authorities 
and function of the former BOEM and the Bureau of Safety and 
Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) into the MMA. Accordingly, this notice 
is issued under the continuing authority of the former BOEM as now 
delegated to the MMA.

Michael D. Olsen,
Acting Director, Marine Minerals Administration.
